answer.rationale: b1 confirms rollback removes write pressure from a bad build, but b2 is the directionally compatible prior of moving traffic off an unhealthy write path without losing writes. Rollback is blocked by compliance on the security patch. Adding capacity or touching read-replica routing during a write-heavy peak risks worsening the write path. The highest-leverage single intervention given the constraints is a controlled regional shift off the hot region to recover p99 while writes continue elsewhere, mirroring how the March degradation was cleared. Verification is requested for b1 (to be certain rollback isn't a viable one-shot given current constraints) and b2 (to confirm the failover procedure remains sound under today's conditions) before committing.
